pages.text: $(bold)Reload Facility$()$(br2)An automated station that reloads ammunition into your weapons.$(br2)$(bold)Features:$()$(br)• Automatically reloads weapons in range$(br)• Supports all ammo types$(br)• Faster than manual reloading$(br)• Requires power/fuel to operate

$(bold)Usage$()$(br2)1. Place the reload facility$(br)2. Right-click to open the interface$(br)3. Insert ammunition into the input slots$(br)4. Stand nearby with weapons$(br)5. Weapons reload automatically$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Build reload facilities near your base for quick rearming!
